prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Account Protection Callout on Sign-In: Display a prominent security banner explaining that signing in permanently links and protects your pet across sessions. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Cloud Registration Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a split layout showcasing an official registration badge and clear cloud sync confirmation. (why: Adoption conversion is low (67.3%) and users report lost pets after account sign-in.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Layout for Path Selection: Redesign the choose_path screen into a spotlight layout showcasing instant companion selection versus custom image adoption. (why: First step drop-off is high with 76.2% conversion and a mean duration of 514 seconds.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Flow After Adoption Confirmation: Reorder the sign-in step to occur after pet adoption so users establish an emotional bond before creating or linking their account. (why: Asking users to sign in early delays adoption and leads to confusion over pet saving.)
4: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Photo Upload Quality Guidance: Add photo selection guidelines and preview checks on the photo upload screen to prevent generation glitches. (why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failures and incorrect pet rendering.)
5: [finish, layout] Desktop Controls Quick-Start Checklist on Finish: Switch the finish screen to a checklist layout detailing basic interaction shortcuts for controlling, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the desktop pet.)
6: [home, notification] Background Render Completion Notification Switch: Enable optional desktop notifications and status updates while the pet finishes loading in the background. (why: The waiting step takes a mean of 2336s, causing users to abandon the app when it is not immediately visible.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Onboarding Welcome Story Streamlining: Simplify the intro story messaging to highlight fast setup and instant desktop pet presence. (why: Initial path selection step has a mean duration of 514s indicating hesitation during intro.)

scores.note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails; low technical cost to add a security callout banner.
Adoption is the largest bottleneck (67.3% conversion); full screen redesign requires new release.
High mean time (514s) at initial step; layout redesign requires UI dev effort.
Flow reordering reduces early friction; requires structural flow changes.
Addresses niche custom photo issues mentioned in 3 emails; quick text/guidance addition.
Finish step loses 26.5%; checklist layout helps post-onboarding retention.
Directly targets the extreme 2336s mean waiting time on the home step.
Simplifies intro copy to address 514s hesitation; simple config/text update.
